macro.text: Fed held rates steady but Warsh struck a hawkish tone at the press conference
The 10-year Treasury yield ticked higher even as the Fed held rates unchanged
Oil fell as Iran diplomacy hopes offset fears of a wider Middle East conflict

Mixed Q3 as profit beat but revenue missed; Ford sees 2027 earnings in line with this year

frontPage.watch: Watch the PCE inflation print and GDP/jobless claims for confirmation of the Fed's hawkish hold, alongside continued fallout in mega-cap tech names after Alphabet's slide and Microsoft's rally.

esForecast.footnote: Ranges cover the full ~23-hour futures session, not just the New York cash session. Sample 3727 sessions from 2012-01-01. Model: ln(next range %) = -5.851 + 0.973×ln(VIX) + 0.313×ln(ATR5 %), R² 54%. Out-of-sample band hit rate 47%. On FOMC, payrolls and CPI days the range is raised 23%, 15% and 6% (how much bigger those sessions ran than the model, 2012-2026).
